name: Copilot Metrics (LGTM)
description: Captures GitHub Copilot OTel traces and visualizes them in a local Grafana LGTM stack (Loki / Grafana / Tempo / Mimir).

installDashboard.description: POST the bundled Grafana dashboard on first start.

dockerMode.description: Docker mode: auto-detect, docker-in-docker, or docker-outside-of-docker.

grafanaPort.description: Port for the Grafana web UI (change if 3000 conflicts with your app).

captureContent.description: Capture full prompt/response content in traces. Sets OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_GENAI_CAPTURE_MESSAGE_CONTENT for the CLI and github.copilot.chat.otel.captureContent for Chat.
